title: Judging Before Propagation: Task-Graph Contextual Integrity for Multi-Agent Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.39532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on persistent memory and inter-agent communication. These capabilities create privacy risks that extend beyond individual interactions: a release appropriate in isolation may become inappropriate when combined with information previously disclosed to a recipient or propagated to downstream agents along the planned workflow. Existing Contextual Integrity (CI) mechanisms for agentic systems typically rely on local judgments that assess each disclosure in isolation, with or without regard to the recipient's history, but do not account for how information propagates downstream. However, compliance at the current boundary does not guarantee appropriateness across the workflow. We introduce Task-Graph Contextual Integrity (TG-CI), to our knowledge the first task-graph-native formalization of Contextual Integrity for multi-agent systems. TG-CI represents a workflow as a Multi-Agent Task Graph (MATG) a

translated_title: 传播前先判断：面向多智能体隐私的任务图上下文完整性
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统日益依赖持久化记忆与智能体间通信。这些能力带来的隐私风险超出了单次交互的范畴：一条在孤立情境下恰当的信息释放，当与先前披露给接收者的信息相结合，或沿计划的工作流传播至下游智能体时，可能变得不恰当。现有的面向智能体系统的上下文完整性机制通常依赖局部判断，孤立地评估每一次披露（无论是否考虑接收者的历史），但并未考虑信息如何向下游传播。然而，在当前边界处的合规并不能保证整个工作流中的恰当性。我们提出了任务图上下文完整性，据我们所知，这是首个针对多智能体系统的任务图原生形式的上下文完整性形式化方法。TG-CI 将工作流表示为多智能体任务图（MATG）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出任务图上下文完整性（TG-CI），这是首个面向多智能体系统的任务图原生的上下文完整性形式化方法，强调必须在信息沿工作流向下游传播之前进行隐私判断，从而克服现有局部判断机制无法保证整个工作流隐私恰当性的缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Task-Graph Contextual Integrity (TG-CI), the first task-graph-native formalization of Contextual Integrity for multi-agent systems, which judges privacy appropriateness before information propagates along the workflow, overcoming the limitation of existing local-judgment mechanisms that cannot guarantee appropriateness across the entire workflow.
